decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful equipment attachment combo, utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid to equip creatures with Colossus Hammer and other powerful equipment. By efficiently tutoring for and equipping these cards, the deck aims to create massive threats on the battlefield that can quickly overwhelm opponents. Additionally, cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce provide disruption and control elements to protect the combo pieces and ensure its success. The deck's strategy revolves around explosive plays and efficient use of its resources to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent to put pressure on the opponent. It utilizes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to clear the way for its creatures. The deck also includes a mix of card draw and counterspells to maintain tempo and control the game. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this UR Aggro deck aims to win the game quickly while staying ahead of the opponent in terms of board presence and card advantage.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play, while also utilizing Wrenn and Six for value. It also includes a spells matter subtheme with cards like Prismari Command and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal spells like Lightning Bolt, while ramping with cards like Explore. The mana base is designed to support multiple colors and includes lands like Dwarven Mine and Boseiju, Who Endures to ensure the combo can be executed smoothly.

The key concept of this deck is to use Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six are included to provide control and card advantage, while cards like Explore and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help to ramp up mana quickly. The deck focuses on combining creativity and different card interactions to catch opponents off guard and overwhelm them with unexpected threats. Lightning Bolt and other spells provide removal and protection, making for a versatile and unpredictable gameplay experience.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to untap our lands, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan and the Titan lands package. The key strategy is to ramp quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to get to Primeval Titan as soon as possible. Once Primeval Titan hits the board, we can search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to deal massive amounts of damage to our opponent. The combination of ramp, land manipulation, and combo potential makes this deck a force to be reckoned with in Modern 1 vs 1 play.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The creatures in this deck have abilities that benefit from being sacrificed or returning from the graveyard, allowing for flexibility in combat and synergy with other cards. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Agadeem's Awakening provide further disruption and advantage in certain matchups. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Archon of Cruelty. The deck also uses Wrenn and Six for card advantage and Jace, the Mind Sculptor for control. It includes a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw to support the combo and protect against disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats, while also utilizing Prismari Command and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional value and flexibility.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Calibrated Blast to quickly and efficiently deal massive damage to the opponent. By using cards like Throes of Chaos to manipulate the top of the deck and ramping up mana with lands like Gemstone Caverns and Scalding Tarn, the deck aims to set up explosive plays with powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Autochthon Wurm. The inclusion of various utility lands and cards like Shadow of Mortality adds versatility and control elements to the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on fast and efficient damage output, utilizing cheap and powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The creatures in the deck, such as Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, provide additional pressure and chip away at the opponent's life points. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Searing Blaze capitalizes on punishing the opponent for playing spells or having creatures on the battlefield. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells and creatures.

This deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to get Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield early and disrupt the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize. Tainted Indulgence allows you to draw cards and control the board while utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value. The combination of Persist and Transmogrify gives you flexibility in dealing with threats, while the rest of the deck provides removal and mana fixing. The strategy is to outmaneuver your opponent through creative card interactions and make powerful plays to take control of the game.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Counterspell and Archmage's Charm. It also utilizes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal direct damage and remove threats. The deck includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage and ensure consistency. With a mix of efficient threats, disruption, and card selection, this UR Aggro deck aims to apply quick pressure and maintain control of the game.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to create a powerful threat. By using equipment tutoring cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift, the deck aims to put the Colossus Hammer onto the battlefield with minimal cost, allowing for swift and aggressive plays. Additionally, the deck includes protection pieces like Esper Sentinel and Sigarda's Aid to ensure the combo pieces can safely reach the battlefield. The deck's focus on efficiency and speed make it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

With a focus on assembling the UrzaTron land combo to generate large amounts of mana, this deck aims to control the game by using powerful planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. By utilizing the versatile abilities of Karn, the Great Creator, and the disruptive nature of cards like Oblivion Stone, this deck can handle a variety of threats while quickly ramping into game-ending threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds another layer of versatility to the deck, making it a challenging opponent for any matchup.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana early in the game. This mana is then used to cast powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Thragtusk, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Walking Ballista for additional threats and removal options. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to assemble UrzaTron quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the Hardened Scales enchantment to maximize the value of +1/+1 counters on creatures. By flooding the board with artifact creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, as well as modular creatures like Hangarback Walker and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, the deck aims to quickly grow its creatures and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga helps to search for key pieces of the combo, while lands like Grove of the Burnwillows and Inkmoth Nexus provide additional utility and win conditions.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful combo using creatures like Memnite, Ornithopter, and Stoneforge Mystic to equip Colossus Hammer onto Puresteel Paladin or other creatures, allowing for a swift win by dealing massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes key cards like Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga to efficiently search for and play the necessary pieces of the combo. By utilizing these cards effectively, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.
